entries.608789d7b37c1fc9: For the fiscal year ended December 2025, the number of clinical-stage pipeline programs nearly doubled from seven at the end of 2024 to 13 at the end of 2025, and milestone fees were also received as partnered programs progressed. entries.786a298a3f2acee5: In the Radiopharmaceutical Business, the Japan Radioisotope Association, a public interest incorporated association, is the major customer, accounting for 58.1% of revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025. By region, domestic revenue of ¥15,757 million accounted for the majority, while upfront contract payments from joint research and development in Europe, which had been large in the previous year, shrank in the period. entries.83dfce4f16834a01: The company states its mission as 'Creating next-generation drugs that transform medical care and patients' lives', leading the research and development of innovative drugs on the basis of its proprietary drug discovery platform system PDPS, and integrating this with PDR Pharma's expertise in the radiopharmaceutical field. Its strategic areas are two: the radiopharmaceutical (RI) area and the Non-RI area. In the Non-RI area, it aims to become a leading company in the discovery of peptide drugs, peptide-drug conjugates (PDCs) and multifunctional peptide complexes (MPCs). It will shift to a 'Discovery & Development' model that promotes drug discovery and development as one, concentrate resources on five priority areas where cyclic peptides can demonstrate competitive advantage, and its long-term vision is evolution into a global pharmaceutical company.
